### Notes

PARTIALLY VERIFIED: the page embeds a HubSpot form (hs-form) whose fields did not render in the fetched HTML, so the exact application mechanism and any additional qualifying questions were NOT inspected; application_mechanism is therefore unknown. The only stated eligibility condition is NVIDIA Inception or NVIDIA Connect membership — no funding, age, headcount or incorporation test is published. Credit coverage: "Persistent storage is covered by Cloud Credits ($0.20 / Gb / month)" and there are "No data ingress and egress fees." Geography note: the availability statement enumerates individual countries but writes "European Union (except for Lithuania)" without enumerating EU member states, so the group id "eu" is used for that portion and LT is recorded as excluded. Note also that https://lambda.ai/startups and https://lambda.ai/startup-program both return 404 — this Inception/Connect page is the only Lambda-owned startup credit page found. Independently re-audited: a second reviewer opened the vendor page and checked the quote, amount and source.
